verbatim: Heroes are a feature rarity that allow specific [[Cards]] placed in the {{Rarity|Champion}} slots to gain an ability. Heroes and the first {{Rarity|Champion}} slot are both unlocked at [[Arenas#Trophy Road|Arena]] 5. Every card with a Hero variation requires 200 {{Icon|I=Hero Shard}} to be unlocked.
The {{Rarity|Champion}} slot is unlocked at Arena 5, while the Wild slot is unlocked at Arena 10.

Only two Heroes can be in a deck at a time, and only in the Hero and Wild slots. Those slots are also shared with {{Rarity|Champion}} card, which means that the player can have 1 Hero and 1 {{Rarity|Champion}} at the same time.
When a Hero activates their ability, but did not start casting it before they are defeated, the Elixir spent on the ability will be refunded once they are defeated.
Heroes can be upgraded by the base card's Wild Cards of respective rarity.
The average Elixir cost in the [[Battle Decks|deck]] menu only counts the base Elixir cost instead of both the base and the ability.

[history 16/3/2026] made it so you can chose the hero (instead of random){{Balance|Buff}} . This also changed the format of Evolution and Hero slots into one Evolution, one Hero and one Wild (from 2 evo and 2 hero){{Balance|Neutral}} .

[history 22/12/2025] a [[Version History#Maintenance Break (22/12/2025)|Maintenance Break]], made it so that you will always get a new hero{{Balance|Buff}}. Additionaly only 1 Hero Slot is available in Classic 1v1s, Classic 2v2s, Classic Challenges, and Grand Challenges{{Balance|Remove}}.
[history 23/2/2026] moved the hero slot to arena 5{{Balance|Neutral}}.  This also removed the Hero Box{{Balance|Remove}}.
[history 4/8/2026] {{Balance|Nerf}} On 4/8/2026 the [[Version History#Balance Changes (4/8/2026)|Balance Update]] made every ability single-use
